title: Person record
description: What a project knows about one person: who the person is, how to address them, and how speech recognition writes their name. One record per person, keyed by email. The data lives in a local cache or in a source of record that the project names, never in this repository.

canonical_name.description: The full name the person is written with.

known_as.description: Nicknames and short forms that people use for the person, each one a correct form.

pronouns.description: The pronouns the person declared. Null when the person declared none. A pronoun is never inferred from a name.

pronouns_source.description: Where the person declared the pronouns, such as a profile field or a conversation, and when. Null when pronouns is null.

email.description: The work email, which is the key of the record.

slack_id.description: The identifier of the person in the chat tool, used to mention them.

github_login.description: The login of the person in the code hosting service.

role.description: The role of the person, as the person or the directory states it.

team.description: The team or area of the person.

transcription_aliases.description: Wrong forms of the name that speech recognition produced and that the person who owns the record confirmed.

heard_as.description: The wrong form, as the transcript wrote it.

confirmed_at.description: The date someone confirmed that this form stands for the person. Absent when the form came from a record that did not date it.

notes.description: Where the form was seen and who confirmed it.

slack_channels.description: Chat channels the person belongs to that matter to the project.

slack_groups.description: Chat user groups the person belongs to that matter to the project.

id.description: The identifier of the group in the chat tool.

handle.description: The handle that mentions the group.

notes.description: Free text the project keeps about the person. Facts only, no guesses.

sources.description: Where the values of the record came from, one item per source and date.

confirmed_at.description: The date the record was last confirmed with a person or with the source of record. Null when it was never dated.

jira_account_id.description: The identifier of the person in the issue tracker, used to assign and mention them.

extensions.description: Blocks that a skill or a module owns, keyed by its name. A block never changes the fields above, and a reader ignores a block it does not know.
